_comment: Policy for normalising E/G/B behavioural & controlled sources. The structural rewrite lives in code (transforms/behavioral_sources.py); this file carries the tunable policy.
_emit_as_bsource_why: Convert E(VALUE/VOL)/G(VALUE/CUR)/TABLE sources to B-sources (Bxxx n+ n- V=/I={...}); B-sources are the native behavioural element in both ngspice and LTspice and avoid dialect-specific VALUE= quirks.
_keep_linear_eg_why: Linear VCVS/VCCS (E/G out+ out- in+ in- gain) are portable as-is; leave them unchanged.
